product_one_liner.value: Design Arena is an AI creation and benchmarking platform for creators, designers, and developers to prompt leading models to make websites, games, images, videos, presentations, or apps and compare the resulting outputs.
product_one_liner.notes: The company homepage says people describe what they want to make, use AI models to create it across several formats, and discover and compare models.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer shows no pricing link, and the /pricing fetch only returns a redirect rather than a pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The reviewed public reporting describes buyers only as unnamed frontier labs and explicitly reports zero named customers; no two attributable customer names were found, so the customer list remains unknown rather than being treated as an empty verified list.

employee_band.notes: The Design Arena LinkedIn record reports 12 employees, which falls in the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The Y Combinator company profile gives Design Arena’s location as San Francisco. | hq_country: The Design Arena LinkedIn company record gives the country as United States and its locality as San Francisco, California.

founded_year.notes: The Y Combinator company profile identifies Design Arena and states “Founded: 2025.”

eng_blog.notes: The company blog index includes technical posts on evaluating mobile app-building agents and building an AI slide-generation pipeline; the posts describe evaluation methodology and the harness/pipeline implementation. This is more than one product or marketing announcement, although the posts do not display engineer bylines in the inspected excerpts.

public_docs.notes: The public Design Arena API documentation includes an introduction and links to a quickstart, API reference, and leaderboard endpoint documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live Intelligence Ashby posting is titled “Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineer,” meeting the AI/ML-role criteria for the company behind DesignArena.

model_provider.value: It lists a broad selection of model providers rather than a single provider, including Anthropic, Google (Gemini), Meta (Llama), and OpenAI.
model_provider.notes: The product’s Model Terms page lists Anthropic, Google (Gemini), Meta (Llama), and OpenAI among the providers/models available through Design Arena, so it does not identify a single exclusive provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: DesignArena’s security page names SOC 2 and ISO 27001 certifications for its hosted infrastructure. | compliance_certs.0: The security page explicitly names SOC 2. | compliance_certs.1: The security page explicitly names ISO 27001.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding report identifies the latest announced round as a seed round. | funding_date: TechCrunch dates the announcement of the seed round to August 3, 2026, which is 2026-08 at the requested month granularity. | funding_amount_usd: TechCrunch reports that Intelligence, the company behind Design Arena, announced a $7.9 million seed round.

raised_18mo.notes: The $7.9 million seed round was announced on August 3, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers page lists an open application and four engineering positions, with no SDR, BDR, or account-executive posting.

launched_6mo.notes: DesignArena’s official X post introduces PDF Arena and is dated November 2, 2026, within six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small Y Combinator profile lists the CEO and CTO as founders, shows a team size of three, and dates the company to 2025; the checked current leadership profile shows no C/VP-level entrant in the lookback period, and no departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The public developer documentation lists API access, quickstart, and leaderboard-reference material, while the current careers page lists an open application and engineering positions; the inspected readable pages name no CRM or sales/marketing system.
